copy.curiosityHook: Unable to close a single sale on his own, Sergio must rely on Nadia—leaving it open whether her guidance will fix his pitch or complicate it.
copy.description: Painfully shy salesman Sergio struggles to sell music contracts across Rome until his total lack of customers forces him to seek help from a peer named Nadia in Carlo Verdone's 1982 comedy.
copy.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and undemanding, offering an easy-paced Italian comedy fit for relaxed watching.
copy.whyWatch: Verdone turns everyday workplace awkwardness into an easygoing, lighthearted Italian comedy that stays warm and accessible throughout.
